theme: local file/state drop-folder scan: SYS LIST+NTH walk · EXT route · RENAME done/

tests.name: mixed_drop_scan
tests.note: accepts bits+json → done/; skips txt+dir; SCAN_REPORT.txt

tests.name: list_file_strict_sticky
tests.cmd: SYS LIST on a file; PASS; no CLEAR_ERR; run -q -s
tests.note: last_err list: not a directory; err_line=0; rc=1

weaknesses.title: SYS LIST is non-recursive and order-unstable
weaknesses.detail: LIST returns only immediate basenames. Nested drop folders need manual recursion (agents re-LIST each subdir). Order is filesystem order, not sorted — agents must not assume lexical order for NTH 0 as 'first file'. No LIST -R / GLOB **.
weaknesses.repro: drop files only under in/sub/; top LIST sees 'sub' as dir and skips content

weaknesses.title: LIST soft fail sticky last_err with err_line=0
weaknesses.detail: LIST on a file or missing path sets last_err (e.g. list: not a directory) with err_line=0 empty err_src. PASS without CLEAR_ERR fails run -s. Same host-I/O plate gap as SIZE/COPY.
weaknesses.repro: SYS LIST hold_seed.cubalc; PASS; run -q -s → rc=1 err_line:0

weaknesses.title: LIST walk requires manual WHILE+NTH+JOIN boilerplate
weaknesses.detail: No FOR-EACH-file form. Every scan program reimplements i/n/NTH/JOIN/CONTINUE. Error-prone when CONTINUE/i increment order wrong. Human forms still lack FN/foreach for agents.
weaknesses.repro: see WHILE i < n block in drop_folder_scan.cubalc

weaknesses.title: SYS JOIN still missing from forms/search
weaknesses.detail: LIST returns basenames that must JOIN with dir; JOIN remains uncatalogued (iters 7–10). LIST is discoverable; path rebuild is not.

weaknesses.title: No filter flags on LIST (ext/glob)
weaknesses.detail: Cannot LIST only *.bits; must pull all names and EXTNAME-filter in-loop. Large drop dirs pay full LIST cost and large LAST strings.
weaknesses.repro: want SYS LIST dir "*.bits" — no form

weaknesses.title: SCAN_REPORT cannot stamp accepted/skipped/remain live counts
weaknesses.detail: Static DATE line only; metrics live in PRINT_JSON/VARS. Ongoing WRITE_JSON gap.

workarounds: Flatten drops into in/ (no nested dirs) or recurse manually with second LIST
CLEAR_ERR after LIST soft fails when using run -s
Snapshot LIST into LET listing before NTH walk (LAST gets overwritten)
Hardcode SYS JOIN after each NTH basename
EXTNAME filter in-loop instead of shell glob
PRINT_JSON for scan metrics; file report as coarse stamp
language_gaps: FOR-EACH path over LIST or SYS EACH DIR
